confirmed_facts.fact: Order ORD-2002 (air fryer, Home category, AED 459.00) was delivered on 2026-10-20 and the return was requested on 2026-10-29, 9.3 days after delivery, inside the 14-day window under Return v2.
The courier picked up the return parcel sealed at 4.86 kg and delivered it to the warehouse; the warehouse recorded receipt at 4.85 kg.
The customer reports the item stops heating after a few minutes.
The item is not serialised, so no serial comparison applies.

findings.description: The warehouse record shows receipt but no inspection time, condition, note, inspector or photos, so the reported fault is neither confirmed nor ruled out. No scans or photos are linked to this case.

evidence.quote: The air fryer stops heating after five minutes.

policy_references.quote: Items returned for a fault are eligible for a refund or replacement within the window if the fault is confirmed at inspection.
Home and other non-electronic items: **14 days** from delivery.
Missing evidence is requested from the party that holds it (seller, courier, warehouse or customer). Never assume what it would show.

findings.rationale: The return is inside the 14-day window and the parcel weight is consistent between pickup and receipt. The fault cannot be confirmed because the warehouse has not inspected the item. A request to the warehouse to complete the inspection has been drafted for a person to approve; the refund or replacement decision should follow the result.
findings.uncertainty_note: Eligibility depends on the inspection result, which is not yet recorded. If confirmed, the refund calculated by code is AED 459 and the defect route (Defect 1.3) also remains available.
